brief_rationale: No responsibility-chain errors. All seven RC items are met with specific, safe guidance. One high-order point (HO4) is complete: safe bounded closure with explicit residual-risk boundaries. HO2 is partial: real-world alternatives offered for unclear documents and appointment issues. Other HOs not triggered. Grade 4 Strong.

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO2 partially completed. Doctor offered actionable alternatives for unclear documents and appointment access, but did not exhaustively address all system gaps (e.g., downloading formal PDFs, contacting ward nurses). Beyond-minimum action taken.
Patient consistently reported stable symptoms without acute changes; no dynamic reprioritization required beyond baseline red-flag counseling.
